substantive_issues.reason: This compound assertion explicitly says all four locations are retained and names null native/external content. The new field/address presence-or-omission rule supports absence_scope/record_scope for its supplied-structure component, while the substantive no-sample/native/external values support cross_level/current_snapshot. Null is not omission, but the new rule does not explicitly distinguish null/status values from structure, or specify precedence when retained-address context accompanies substantive inter-domain content. Clarify before blind responses; do not count consulted domains alone as cross_level.

The assertion compares a represented unseen/null native-and-external row with stored e1. The new presence rule can be read as a content-availability/absence_scope claim; the existing key treats explicit null and no-sample statuses as substantive native/external content at the current snapshot. A general written distinction and compound-claim precedence are required, rather than assuming the original label remains valid.
